audit.why: 46.11% over 488 games, HARD at 8/10, and every chart row reads Olaf in both phases[N].side and win[N], matching the packet exactly. The rating curve (2/10 early easing to 3-4/10) is a fair reflection of a lane you never win outright.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike said Ragnarok simply makes him immune to slows and CC, with no cooldown and no condition.
audit.why: Riot's text is conditional: he is immune to disables 'for as long as he keeps attacking', and the ability is 100/90/80s. That condition is the only counterplay the spike has — stop being attackable and the immunity lapses — and the 100s is when you are allowed to fight at all.
audit.corrected: whys[4] and mid now state the keeps-swinging condition and the 100s cooldown.
sources: enemyKit R: 100/90/80, 400 range, 'immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking'

audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes his sustain to 'Vicious Strikes (W) lifesteal' in five places. Per the kit his W is Tough It Out — Attack Speed and a Shield, 16/15/14/13/12s, no lifesteal. The lifesteal is on his passive, Berserker Rage, and it scales with his MISSING health. Undertow's Armor shred and its reset-on-pickup are also never mentioned.
audit.why: This inverts the trade maths. Chipping him low does not starve his sustain — it feeds it, because Berserker Rage gets stronger as he drops, which is exactly the zone your own passive wants him in. And a player who does not know Undertow resets on pickup treats a 9s cooldown as if it were reliable, when standing on the axe is what actually makes it 9s.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, spikes[2].text, early, mid, whys[1] and wants.foe[2] now credit Berserker Rage for the lifesteal and Tough It Out for the shield; report[5].t and dosFull[0].d state Undertow's 9s flat, Armor shred and pickup reset.
